definitions.GPU times: CUPTI concurrent activity; union clips to simulate/fetch boundaries. Kernel category sums overlap across streams and must not be added to wall time.
definitions.no_gpu_activity_ms: No kernel/copy/memset from this process in the simulation interval. Not a measure of global GPU idleness or proof all time is CPU computation.
definitions.CPU: Process and thread CPU clocks measure core-ms, excluding sleeping/descheduling, but including spinning and driver/profiler CPU. Exclusive scopes subtract same-thread synchronous children only. Parallel core-ms are not additive wall-ms.
definitions.bodies: PhysX registered dynamic plus kinematic actors, including retained parent/body lifecycle objects; distinct from logical rigid clusters.
definitions.awake_bodies: PhysX CPU island scheduling counters from last solver pass: active dynamic + active kinematic. This integrated path disables sleeping; these are not a demonstrated GPU sleep mask.
definitions.pre_solve_pairs: GPU pre-solve contact-manager pairs processed across trial and correction, not unique touching pairs; normalContacts counts solved reports separately.
definitions.stress_active_bonds: Retained stress topology membership after accepted topology update; not count of nonconverged bonds processed in each solver iteration.
definitions.public_contact_stats: Legacy contact_pairs, contact_pairs_with_contacts and solver_rows are not complete GPU work counters; excluded from scaling analysis.
definitions.warmup: First 60 accepted steps excluded; initial destruction allocation spikes remain part of measurement.
definitions.profiling: Tracing itself has overhead; use untraced replicates for elapsed time. No isolated-device or 60-second 60Hz qualification.
